node.title: Re^3: inconsistent module access
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It's what [choroba] [id://11145025|said]: because you're using [doc://require] instead of [doc://use], the module's import method is not called, which is required for the module to work correctly.

$data = IO::All::io() Results in a different error.

That's because there is no sub io anywhere in the distribution. io is [https://metacpan.org/release/FREW/IO-All-0.87/source/lib/IO/All/Base.pm#L6|dynamically generated] by the aforementioned import in the caller's package. The unusual error comes from the fact that the call gets sent to IO::All::AUTOLOAD(), which doesn't handle io.

You need to say either use IO::All; or require IO::All; IO::All->import(); for the module to work correctly.
